description: Edit an existing video on the connected channel: title, description, tags, privacy (unlisted | public | private), category, schedule (publishAt; "" clears it), madeForKids, aiGenerated, licence, embedding, stats visibility, languages + per-language translations, paid-placement disclosure and brand partner. THIS IS HOW YOU FLIP AN UNLISTED UPLOAD PUBLIC. Making a video PUBLIC puts it on the channel where anyone can find it, so show the user exactly what will change and get an explicit yes before calling with privacy:"public". Fields you omit are left untouched; every change is read back from YouTube and any field it did not apply is named. Needs a connected YouTube channel.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

aiGenerated.description: YouTube’s “altered or synthetic content” label. OMIT IT and the value already on the post stays; a post that never had one is decided from provenance (a Hermoso render is declared, real footage from upload_file or an external URL is not). true/false overrides.

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in — id or exact name from list_brands (a shared workspace: its profile id). Needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to; applies to THIS CALL ONLY. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

brandPartner.description: sponsoring brand's channel id (UC…) or @handle — gives that brand access to run the video as a partnership ad; "" unlinks (update only)

embeddable.description: true = allow embedding on other sites

localizations.description: translated title/description per language, e.g. {"es":{"title":"…"}}; needs defaultLanguage

madeForKids.description: true = made for kids; false = not made for kids

paidProductPlacement.description: true = contains PAID product placement (sponsored) — YouTube shows the disclosure; legally required for sponsored content

privacy.description: public = live on the channel; confirm with the user first

publicStatsViewable.description: true = show public view and like counts

publishAt.description: ISO date-time to go public; keeps it private until then; "" clears a schedule

tags.description: video tags, up to 30; omit to leave the current tags

name: update_youtube_video
title: Update a YouTube video’s details
